newsitem.title: USA: Engelhard/ICC signs Middle East market agreements.
newsitem.headline: Engelhard/ICC signs Middle East market agreements.

text.p: Engelhard/ICC said on Monday it had signed market development and assembly agreements for the Middle East region with air conditioning manufacturer Petra Engineering Industries Co and with Engineering Consultancy Office of Cairo, an engineering and contracting firm.
Engelhard/ICC is a joint venture of ICC Technologies Inc and Engelhard Corp.

"The growth in the Middle East, along with the severe humidity and temperatures and a need for efficient air cooling systems in the region, indicates a strong market opportunity for Engelhard/ICC's proprietary desiccant technology air conditioning units," said Engelhard/ICC chief executive Irwin Gross.

Under the terms of the agreement with Petra, the company has the right to sell Engelhard/ICC's humidity control systems in the United Arab Emirates, Jordan, Lebanon, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman and Yemen with assembly rights in Jordan.

The agreement with Engineering Consultancy Office grants it the right to sell humidity control units and equipment in Egypt, Saudi Arabia and Kuwait with the right to assemble Engelhard/ICC systems in Egypt.
Engelhard/ICC manufactures and markets humidity control systems to supplement or replace conventional air conditioning systems.
